tests: judges every default-gate member of the family, read from the test directory and vitest.config.ts
pins the members that import the marked twins: the three suites that drive real hosts, and the helper's own unit rows
%s: G1 drives hosts only through the marked twins, never a raw launch or connect value import
%s: G2 holds no raw timer - a timed wait is pollFor and a held window is holdOpen
%s: G3 holds no fixed-count or clock-deadline poll loop (the pre-cure shape)
%s: G4 a hook that stops hosts reports a lapse only after its cleanup, under HOST_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS
reads each rule's own shape: a planted member with one site per rule yields exactly its G1-G4 findings (instrument check)
wb-nqbd F4 frozen shape, as collected: this file's tests equal the roster's, expanded over the judged set, in order and in run mode, and the roster's shape equals the frozen-shape literal
wb-nqbd F1 kill controls: vitest's wait helpers and AbortSignal.timeout read as G2 - by name on any receiver, by a string key or through a destructured binding
wb-nqbd F2 kill controls: a for, while or do loop whose condition joins any relational bound with && reads as G3 - a countdown, a reversed or named bound, a while or do counter

wb-nqbd F3 kill controls: a timer global by a string key and Atomics.wait read as G2, and an afterEach, afterAll, beforeEach or beforeAll hook that stops hosts - itself or through module-local functions, by name, a vitest import alias or a namespace member - reads as G4

wb-vh7c F1 kill controls: a for, while or do loop whose condition joins with && a counter of the loop reads as G3 - compared by ===, ==, !== or != against a literal or a named bound (on either side, under a negation too), or read as its truth value (n--, --n, n -= 1, a member's step, or n stepped in the body)

wb-vh7c F2 kill controls: vitest's other four hooks that stop hosts read as G4 - onTestFinished and onTestFailed (by name, a vitest import alias, a test-context member, a destructured binding, or a variable bound to one by name or as a member), aroundEach and aroundAll - and so does every fixture that stops hosts (extend, override or scoped; inline, as a tuple, through a builder's onCleanup or a module-local function), which no timeout bounds
wb-vh7c F2 hook kinds: the hooks G4 reads by name are exactly vitest's own hook exports (before*, after*, around* and onTest*), read from the vitest module

wb-n5xs F1 kill controls: a for, while or do loop whose condition joins with && a counter of the loop read through a TypeScript type-level wrapper (as, an angle-bracket assertion, satisfies or the non-null !, nested too) reads as G3 - as its truth value or under an equality operator, the wrapper around the step itself or around a counter the loop steps, bare or wrapped, in its incrementor or body

wb-n5xs F1, wb-69ur F2 wrapper kinds: the wrappers G3 reads a counter through are exactly TypeScript's own type-level ones, kind by kind (the syntax kinds its isOuterExpression files under OuterExpressionKinds.Assertions, read over its whole SyntaxKind enum and on an instance of every outer expression: as and an angle-bracket assertion, satisfies, the non-null !), and a T1 kill control plants each one in both of the reading's forms, read from the wrappers its finding's condition unwraps, which the roster pins

wb-69ur F1 kill controls: a for, while or do loop whose condition joins with && a member counter of the loop (a property or an element, of an object or of this) reads as G3 when parentheses or a TypeScript type-level wrapper sit on a link of its member chain instead of around the counter, whichever side of the loop holds them (its condition, its incrementor or its body), as its truth value or under an equality operator, and when an optional chain, a literal element key or the spacing around a link spells the same member; the wrappers each finding's condition unwraps are the roster's, and they cover every type-level wrapper kind

wb-nqbd, wb-vh7c, wb-n5xs and wb-69ur negative controls: a settled hook (an onTestFinished among them), a hook or a fixture that stops nothing, a loop without && (a countdown among them), a loop whose && joins neither a relational bound nor a counter of its own (an inequality on a state, an equality on a flag while another value counts, a state or a flag read through a TypeScript wrapper, and another receiver's member, another member or another element read through a wrapper while a member counts), text alone and another object's members yield no finding; the controls are the roster's, in order
wb-nqbd F5 named residuals: every residual the header names has quiet rows in the roster, and each quiet row's planted member yields no finding
wb-nqbd F5 R-RAISE-SITE: the family's raiseTransportLapse call rows equal the roster's - socket-base's 60-byte TMPDIR row and the helper's own unit row
wb-nqbd F4 frozen shape, as run: this file's tests equal the roster's, expanded over the judged set, and every other test ran before this last case
